newsitem.title: DUBAI: Trade slow in UAE shares, index slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Trade slow in UAE shares, index slightly up.

text.p: Trade on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market was slow in the week to Thursday with the index gaining a modest 6.25 points, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index rose to 2,498.63 points from 2,492.38 the previous week.
Eight shares were up, three down and 15 steady this week.

Most banking shares stuck to recent levels. NBAD closed at 480, down 10 dirhams, equal to the size of the bank's dividend for 1996. Earlier in the week the bank announced net profit of 313.79 million dirhams from 214.95 million in 1995.
Union National Bank was up five dirhams at 360.
Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, also gained five dirhams at 945. Abu Dhabi National Hotels Company was up 10 dirhams at 1,060.
Abu Dhabi Aviation and Al Dhafra Insurance rose five dirhams each to 665 and 865 respectively.
